name.en-US: Sermons for the Seasons of the Year

description.la: Sermones Bernardi per annum de tempore, ab Adventu ad Dedicationem ecclesiae, in ordinem anni liturgici dispositi.
description.en-US: Bernard’s sermons for the liturgical year, from Advent through Christmas, Epiphany, Lent, Easter, the Ascension and Pentecost to the Sundays after Pentecost and the Dedication of a church, grouped by feast in the order of the year. The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 183, 1854). Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os sermões de Bernardo para o ano litúrgico, do Advento ao Natal, à Epifania, à Quaresma, à Páscoa, à Ascensão, a Pentecostes, aos domingos depois de Pentecostes e à Dedicação da igreja, agrupados por festa na ordem do ano.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182-184)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182-184 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), works 6169, 6211, 6198, 6186, 6178, 6203, 6171, 6181, 6185, 6180, 6177, 6190, 6176, 6189, 6204, 6207, 6206, 6183, 6191, 6172, 6173, 6214, 6188, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: One group per feast or piece, as the Corpus Corporum divides them. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
